text: Because the total supply of DAO tokens is pre-determined in code, dilution by central administrators such as government officials or self-interested or biased executives is impossible.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America

abstract: because the total supply of tokens is pre-determined in the DAO code, dilution by central administrators such as government officials or self- interested or biased executives/supervisors/CEOs is impossible, which further illustrates the power of blockchain structures such as the DAO.

value: DAOs with a fixed token supply fixed in open source code
